name: resume-optimizer
description: Three skills for job applications, none of which fabricates a word. match-analysis scores one job description against your background and tells you whether to apply. resume-optimizer tailors your resume to a job description — or generates a CV from your background file — with a fresh-context review and an ATS check on the rendered PDF. cover-letter writes the one-page letter that ties them together, with a hook drawn from your own material. Your standing preferences (page size, page limit, language, deal-breakers) live in the background file and every skill reads them.
